creators.name: Manwen Liao
creators.role: PhD researcher, The University of Hong Kong
creators.bio: First author of MegaParts (2026), developed during an internship at Shanghai AI Laboratory with the team behind MeshCoder.
creators.why: MegaParts scales part-aware 3D generation to objects of up to 300 separate parts.
creators.bio_zh: MegaParts（2026）第一作者，该工作在上海人工智能实验室实习期间与 MeshCoder 团队合作完成。
creators.why_zh: MegaParts 把部件级三维生成扩展到最多由 300 个独立部件组成的物体。

creators.role_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: PAT3D（ICLR 2026）第一作者，该工作由卡内基梅隆大学与香港大学、香港科技大学合作完成。

works.title: MegaParts
works.description: Research model from Shanghai AI Laboratory, The University of Hong Kong and partner universities that generates a 3D object from a text prompt as an assembly of up to 300 separate part meshes; an object bounding box and per-part boxes can be given as spatial instructions. It is the base model of MeshCoder 1.5 and was published as a technical report with a project page in August 2026; code was announced but not released as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: 上海人工智能实验室、香港大学与多所合作高校推出的研究模型：根据一句文字提示生成由最多 300 个独立部件网格组装而成的三维物体，还可以用整体包围盒和每个部件的包围盒作为空间指令。它是 MeshCoder 1.5 的基础模型，2026 年 8 月以技术报告和项目主页形式发布；截至 2026 年 10 月，代码已宣布但尚未公开。
works.idea_en: Complex props such as a camera, a dish rack or a building come out as hundreds of editable, articulable pieces rather than one fused shell.
works.idea_zh: 相机、碗碟架或一栋建筑这样的复杂道具，生成出来就是数百个可编辑、可做关节的部件，而不是一整块熔合的外壳。
works.method: A causal vector-quantized tokenizer gives each part an adaptive number of shape tokens (16 to 4,096 by geometric complexity), and a long-context language model generates the object box, the part boxes and the part shape tokens as one sequence of up to 256K tokens.
works.method_zh: 因果向量量化分词器按几何复杂度给每个部件分配 16 到 4096 个不等的形状 token，再由长上下文语言模型把物体包围盒、部件包围盒和部件形状 token 作为一条最长 256K token 的序列依次生成。

paper.title: MegaParts: Scaling Part-Aware 3D Object Generation to 300 Parts via Token-Efficient Autoregressive Modeling

works.title: Mira-Scene
works.description: Open model from VAST and The University of Hong Kong that turns a single photo into an editable 3D scene: every object is generated as its own mesh and placed where it sits in the image, and an environment map is added. The inference code, both checkpoints and the fine-tuning data are public; the authors report 39.8% higher 3D-IoU layout accuracy than SAM 3D.
works.description_zh: VAST 与香港大学推出的开源模型：把一张照片变成可编辑的三维场景，每个物体都单独生成为网格并放到它在照片中的位置，再补上环境贴图。推理代码、两个阶段的权重和微调数据均已公开；作者报告其布局精度的 3D-IoU 比 SAM 3D 高 39.8%。
works.idea_en: A photo of a real room becomes a set of separate, movable objects in the right places, a starting point for restaging or simulating that room.
works.idea_zh: 一张真实房间的照片变成一组摆在正确位置、可以单独移动的物体，可据此重新布置或仿真这个房间。
works.method: A multimodal diffusion transformer generates each object's geometry together with a Canonical Coordinate Map that links every visible pixel to a point in the object's own bounded space; matched against a monocular point map, it gives each object's pose by robust geometric alignment, so training needs only object-level 3D data and no scene layout labels.
works.method_zh: 多模态扩散 Transformer 同时生成每个物体的几何和一张规范坐标图（Canonical Coordinate Map），把每个可见像素对应到物体自身有界空间中的一点；再与单目几何估计得到的点云图匹配，通过稳健的几何对齐求出每个物体的位姿，因此训练只需物体级三维数据，无需场景布局标注。

paper.title: Mira-Scene: Pixel-Aligned Layouts for Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction

works.title: PAT3D
works.description: Carnegie Mellon University system, with The University of Hong Kong and HKUST, that turns a text prompt into a 3D scene whose objects rest under gravity without passing through one another, so the scene can be loaded straight into a simulator for editing or robot manipulation. Published at ICLR 2026 with code and data.
works.description_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学与香港大学、香港科技大学合作的系统：把一句文字提示变成三维场景，其中的物体在重力下稳定放置、彼此不穿插，因此场景可以直接载入仿真器做编辑或机器人操作。发表于 ICLR 2026，并公开了代码和数据。
works.idea_en: Generated rooms that obey gravity and contact can be pushed, grasped and rearranged instead of only looked at.
works.idea_zh: 遵守重力与接触的生成房间可以被推、被抓取、被重新布置，而不只是用来看。
works.method: A generated reference image fixes the spatial relations, 3D assets come from vision foundation models, a vision-language model extracts a hierarchical scene tree, and a differentiable rigid-body simulator settles the layout to static equilibrium, with simulation-in-the-loop optimization keeping it consistent with the prompt.
works.method_zh: 先生成一张参考图确定物体间的空间关系，用视觉基础模型生成三维资产，再由视觉语言模型提取层级场景树；可微刚体仿真器让布局在重力下达到静态平衡，仿真在环的优化则保证结果仍符合提示词。
